description: This Java interface 'Hashes' provides hash functions including Murmur-3 and SHA-256-based digest functions for strings, intended for use in hashing algorithms and related utilities within the project.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a collection of integer seeds used for hashing.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Default method that hashes a string with each seed, returning a list of hash codes.

methods.name: murmurHash
methods.description: Static method that computes a Murmur-3 hash for a given string and seed.

methods.name: digestStringsToIntegers
methods.description: Static method that generates a list of pseudorandom integers by digesting a string seed with SHA-256 repeatedly.

methods.name: getSha256
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns a SHA-256 MessageDigest instance.
